evidence.text:
# Task List

1. ⏳ Reading and rewording the issue; clarify requirements

2. ⏳ Run test suite to see failures related to autoreloader

3. ⏳ Explore repository to locate autoreloader code and -m handling

4. ⏳ Create minimal reproduction script to simulate python -m module runserver scenario

5. ⏳ Analyze fix approach and determine minimal code changes

6. ⏳ Implement code changes in repository

7. ⏳ Verify fix with reproduction and run affected tests

8. ⏳ Final review against issue requirements and base commit
